nodes.name: Receive Operator Intent
nodes.notes: Sub-workflow trigger. Expected input keeps the webhook-compatible shape: { body: { operator_id, intent_text, reason } }.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'cyankiwi/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-AWQ-8bit', messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'Extract compact domain intent JSON only. Do not generate patch IDs, TRT IDs, status, operations, or JSON Patch. Allowed lines: line_1,line_2,line_3,line_4. Allowed goals: ROUTINE_CLASSIFICATION,TRAUMA_SET_PRIORITY,BACKLOG_CLEARING. Allowed instruments: SCISSORS,FORCEPS,CLAMPS,RETRACTOR. Allowed abnormal strategies: STOP_LINE,CONTINUE_FEASIBLE_TASKS,ASK_OPERATOR. Tooling required_scope values: ALLOWED_INSTRUMENTS,ALL_SUPPORTED_INSTRUMENTS,SELECTED_TOOLING,NONE. target_scope: single line=SINGLE_LINE, several lines=MULTIPLE_LINES, all/every/each production line=ALL_LINES with target_lines=[]. Action rules: PROPOSE_PATCH only for supported goal, instrument scope, KPI limit, tooling policy, abnormal strategy, or multi-line policy updates; otherwise NEEDS_CLARIFICATION or UNSUPPORTED_REQUEST. TASK_GOAL_UPDATE requires goal. KPI_LIMIT_UPDATE, TOOLING_POLICY_UPDATE, INSTRUMENT_SCOPE_UPDATE, and PRIORITY_UPDATE do not require goal. KPI_LIMIT_UPDATE requests do not require goal. throughput/hr, throughput per hour, min throughput, minimum throughput, or KPI throughput => kpi_updates.min_throughput_per_hour=<integer> and goal=null unless the user explicitly asks for a supported goal. highest priority/highest level priority/priority to the highest level => priority=5. lowest priority => priority=1. Do not map priority language to goal. Do not set goal=TRAUMA_SET_PRIORITY unless the user explicitly asks for Trauma Set priority. no deadline => kpi_updates.deadline_minutes=null. no maximum downtime limit => kpi_updates.max_downtime_seconds=null. allowed_instruments is selected tooling for the strategy, not robot capability. allowed_instruments=[] means no tooling selected. allowed_instruments=["SCISSORS","FORCEPS","CLAMPS","RETRACTOR"] means all supported tooling selected. excluded_instruments=[] means no explicit exclusions. select no tooling or do not want all tooling selected => tooling_policy.required_scope=NONE, allowed_instruments=[], excluded_instruments=[]. select all tooling => allowed_instruments=["SCISSORS","FORCEPS","CLAMPS","RETRACTOR"], excluded_instruments=[]. all tooling required by each production line or mark all tooling required for each production line as mandatory => tooling_policy.required_scope=ALL_SUPPORTED_INSTRUMENTS, allowed_instruments=["SCISSORS","FORCEPS","CLAMPS","RETRACTOR"], excluded_instruments=[]. all supported instruments required on every line => tooling_policy.required_scope=ALL_SUPPORTED_INSTRUMENTS, allowed_instruments=["SCISSORS","FORCEPS","CLAMPS","RETRACTOR"], excluded_instruments=[]. Never use allowed_instruments=[] with tooling_policy.required_scope=ALL_SUPPORTED_INSTRUMENTS. Entanglement is not an instrument exclusion; use abnormal_strategy for tangled tooling events.' }, { role: 'user', content: `Operator intent: ${$('Receive Operator Intent').first().json.body.intent_text}. Return action,line_id,target_scope,target_lines,goal,priority,allowed_instruments,excluded_instruments,kpi_updates,tooling_policy,abnormal_strategy,clarification_questions,unsupported_terms,detected_request_types,request_types.` } ], temperature: 0.0, max_tokens: 768, structured_outputs: { json: $('Get Intent Context').first().json.llm_candidate_generation_schema } } }}

nodes.name: LLM Generate Intent Patch
nodes.notes: Calls vLLM for a domain-level candidate only. It does not generate JSON Patch operations and does not validate semantics.

nodes.name: Normalize Candidate Patch
nodes.notes: Parses the first structured vLLM response. Truncated or incomplete JSON is retried automatically once.

nodes.name: Intent Candidate Needs Retry?
nodes.notes: Retries once when the first intent candidate response is truncated or not complete JSON.

nodes.name: Retry LLM Generate Intent Patch
nodes.notes: One automatic retry for truncated or incomplete domain candidate JSON. Does not affect other vLLM nodes.

nodes.name: Normalize Retried Candidate Patch
nodes.notes: Normalizes retry output. If retry fails, returns NEEDS_REVISION with a controlled error.

nodes.name: Normalize Python Candidate Result
nodes.notes: Converts successful Python normalization and expected HTTP business-rule errors into normal workflow envelopes.

nodes.name: Python Candidate Accepted?
nodes.notes: Routes normal Python candidate results to patch validation and leaves REJECTED envelopes as terminal output for chat formatting.

nodes.name: Return Python Candidate Rejection
nodes.notes: Terminal pass-through for expected Python business-rule rejections so the parent chat workflow can format them.

nodes.name: Return Reviewed Candidate
nodes.notes: Derives affected_lines from candidate_patch.operations after Python normalization and validation.

assignments.name: context
assignments.value: ={{ { ...($('Receive Operator Intent').first().json.context || {}), operator_id: $('Receive Operator Intent').first().json.context?.operator_id || $('Receive Operator Intent').first().json.body?.operator_id || $('Receive Operator Intent').first().json.operator_id || null, scenario_spec_ids: $('Receive Operator Intent').first().json.context?.scenario_spec_ids || [] } }}

assignments.name: ids
assignments.value: ={{ { patch_id: null, release_id: null, audit_id: null, trt_id: null, trt_version: null, reconciliation_plan_id: null, scenario_spec_id: null } }}

assignments.name: payload
assignments.value: ={{ { rejection_reasons: $json.rejection_reasons || ['Candidate was not accepted for review.'], clarification_prompt: 'Please revise the request or provide missing fields.' } }}
